bear_case.title: China dominates cells
bear_case.description: CATL (40.2%) and BYD (14.4%) hold over half of global EV/storage battery shipments through May 2026 (CATL installs +23% YoY); together they command ~64% of China's domestic market. Western integrators compete on software and services, not hardware cost.

bear_case.title: Policy whiplash
bear_case.description: Section 301 duties on non-EV lithium-ion (grid BESS) cells jumped from 7.5% to 25% effective Jan 1, 2026, pushing the effective combined US import tariff on Chinese ESS batteries to ~58.4% (from 40.9%); new FEOC rules cap Chinese-sourced content at 45% of manufacturing cost for ITC eligibility.

bear_case.title: Margin compression
bear_case.description: Tesla's own Q2 print is fresh evidence: energy-segment margin nearly halved QoQ (39.5% → 20.4%) on a warranty charge and a lapsed tariff benefit, plus falling industrial-storage ASPs. Software attach remains the differentiator for integrators.

bear_case.title: Solid-state timelines
bear_case.description: QuantumScape's Honda pact and Straubel board addition are votes of confidence, but the company is still burning ~$65M/quarter with $859M liquidity that analysts say must last until "late this decade" before meaningful revenue arrives.

catalysts.title: GE Vernova posts blowout Q2
catalysts.description: Orders +88% YoY to $24.2B; total backlog $176B (+$13B QoQ, on track for $200B by 2027); Electrification backlog $41B (+69% YoY); 2026 revenue guide raised to $45.5–46.5B.

catalysts.title: Tesla Q2: record revenue, energy margin hit
catalysts.description: $28.2B record revenue overall; energy-segment margin fell to 20.4% from 39.5% on a $240M warranty charge and a lapsed tariff benefit, despite 13.5 GWh deployed (+53% QoQ).

catalysts.title: QuantumScape shares slide despite narrower loss
catalysts.description: Q2 net loss $98.2M on $859M liquidity; Honda partnership and amended VW/PowerCo milestones highlighted, but cell-output ramp and pre-revenue timeline keep investors cautious.

catalysts.title: Eos Energy completes rights offering
catalysts.description: Raised ~$263M total to fund Frontier Power USA and unlock $1B+ of project capital; pre-announced record Q2 revenue of $68–69M (~3x shipments) and backlog of $807M.

catalysts.title: Data-center co-located storage deals
catalysts.description: Energy North's 16 GWh Project Ares (Australia) and Firmus's 600 MW supply deal; BloombergNEF now tracks 4.9 GW of storage co-located with onsite generation at data centers globally.

catalysts.title: Fluence ships first US-made LFP cells
catalysts.description: Domestic lithium-iron-phosphate production begins ahead of Q3 earnings (Aug 5), a step toward FEOC-compliant, tariff-insulated supply.
